probes.name: answer_fills_outline_result
probes.text:
WITH hollow AS (
    SELECT key, step, content
    FROM 'tables/steps.parquet'
    WHERE kind = 'tool_result'
      AND (length(trim(content)) = 0
           OR regexp_matches(trim(content), '^\[?\s*\]$')
           OR regexp_matches(content, '(?i)(focando somente nos t[oó]picos|topics below|the following topics only)'))
), answered AS (
    SELECT h.key AS key, h.step AS result_step, m.step AS answer_step, m.content AS answer
    FROM hollow h
    JOIN 'tables/steps.parquet' m
      ON m.key = h.key AND m.step > h.step AND m.role = 'assistant' AND m.kind = 'message'
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY h.key, h.step ORDER BY m.step) = 1
), filling AS (
    SELECT key, result_step, answer_step, answer
    FROM answered
    WHERE length(answer) > 300
      AND NOT regexp_matches(answer, '(?i)(there (have|has) been no|no (data|results|records|sales|information|thoughts|entries)|nothing (to|was|has|found)|wasn.t able|not available|unavailable|isn.t available|unfortunately|não há|nenhum)')
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY result_step) = 1
)
SELECT key AS key, answer_step AS step,
       'the answer presents findings of its own where the result at step ' || CAST(result_step AS VARCHAR) || ' holds only an outline or holds nothing: ' || left(split_part(trim(answer), chr(10), 1), 90) AS note
FROM filling
ORDER BY 1, 2
probes.why: The round 1 probe of this facet reports the result that holds only an outline, and this probe reports the answer that fills it, which is the place where the findings are made up. It reports one position per trajectory, at the answer that follows the first hollow result. Its result test and its answer test are the ones of outline_result_filled_in, so the empty sales list of toucan/775690ae-92a6-5be3-9a33-b0363a38e66d stays out because its answer reports the empty result, and toucan/e5ba7254-e907-5f46-8918-270e6f2cb087 stays out because the text of its result says in words that it holds nothing. It should find #8 of toucan/70d18959-d21d-5aa8-87e2-1fd120f8e31d and #8 of toucan/bb86a6e1-aa5c-5f99-998b-0c61e932115c, the answers that turn three outlines into findings.
